core.title: Stainless Steel European Mortise Deadbolt with 203 Rose, AHI SIG203-EU56

text.description_html:
AHI Stainless Steel European Mortise Deadbolt with 203 Rose

European style deadbolt with satin stainless steel door levers and 2" square roses. European Mortise Lockcase: Heavy duty for residential, commercial and multifamily housing. Single cylinder european profile cylinder with Schlage C keyway.

Also available: Matching European Mortise Leverset for interior doors.

All Stainless Steel Trim: Extremely resistant to corrosion, knocks, scratches and abrasion making it an ideal material for door hardware. It needs little looking after and does not degrade in appearance or function with use.

Specifications:

  • Function: Single Cylinder Entry (key outside with thumbturn inside)
  • Mortise Case Faceplate: Stainless steel 20mm Wide x 235mm High
  • Deadbolt: Double throw
  • Handing: Handed, field reversible
  • Backset: Optional 70mm (2-3/4"), 60mm (2-3/8") or 50mm (2")
  • Door Thickness: 1-1/2" (38mm) Minimum thickness, optional up to 3" thick
  • Strike plate: Stainless steel
  • Trim Plates: 50mm (2") Square
  • Trim Plate Thickness: 9mm (3/8")
  • Solid Stainless Steel Trim
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • AHI EU1000 Series European Mortise Lock Dimensions

Sold as a set, (for 1 door). Set includes, european profile cylinder with 50mm square roses, mortise lock case, face plate, strike plate, spindles and installation screws.
